title: Card Lock Treatment and Authorization Hold Periods by Tier — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
The Pocketwire Visa Debit Card tiers differ in two operational settings: whether recurring charges keep settling while a card is locked, and how long an unsettled authorization hold stays before Pocketwire releases it.

| Card tier | Recurring charges from merchants the card already paid keep settling while locked | Standard hold release period (calendar days after the authorization date) | Extended hold release period (calendar days after the authorization date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | no | 7 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | no | 7 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | yes | 7 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | yes | 7 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | yes | 5 | 21 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | yes | 5 | 21 |

**Standing notes**

- An *extended hold* is a hold placed by a hotel, a car rental, or a fuel pre-authorization above the standard hold. Every other authorization hold is a *standard hold*.
- The release periods are the calendar days after the authorization date after which an unsettled hold is released.
- The lock column covers only recurring charges from merchants the card has already paid. It gives no other purchase a way through a lock.
